The path element is the element's authored canonical JSON, built by itemElem in child() before any member is substituted, but credentialAt decides whether to redact it with holds(), which reads the element's nodes as they are when the first warning below the element is reported. Redaction also depends on member order and on variable values, so the form of the path tells the reader whether a variable's value is credential-shaped. This contradicts the package doc ('no RZ-CFG-013 warning names a credential ... in its path'; the detectors' 'result never depends on the Environment') and the ApplyWith doc ('never reveals a variable's value').
